name: Dromoka
description: Dromoka is the dragonlord who leads the Dromoka clan and rules the Abzan on Tarkir, forbidding necromancy and ancestor worship.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

summary.text: Dromoka is the dragonlord who leads the Dromoka clan and rules the Abzan on Tarkir, forbidding necromancy and ancestor worship.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

bio.text: Dromoka is the dominant dragon of her brood, the only dragon the Abzan admire, and she commands her brood and the dragons' obedience.
In war against the Abzan the first battle cost over a thousand soldiers without any damage to her, and Dromoka grants Daghatar an audience, laughing at his plea for peace.

citations.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.
"No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

bio.text: She tells Daghatar that binding the dead to serve the living is necromancy, which she cannot tolerate, and he orders every kin-tree uprooted and necromancy forbidden.

citations.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.
"No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

bio.text: Daghatar destroys the Remembrance and pledges his clan to her service, while Reyhan refuses to kneel to her and dies in the khanfall.

citations.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

citations.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citations.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

bio.text: Her law outlaws ancestor magic, and a few renegade spirit speakers hide kin-trees.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

bio.text: Later, the Abzan rebel against her monsters, and Felothar, whom she stripped of her place and ordered executed, prepares with the rebels for battle against Dromoka's forces.

citations.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.
"Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

status.text: As of the latest story Dromoka still rules the Abzan, and the rebels are preparing to battle her forces.

citations.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.
"Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: After Sarkhan sends Ugin into slumber in 3279 AR, Dromoka's brood commits systematic genocide against the Abzan.
timeline.quote: Dromoka and her brood thus laid a systematic genocide on the Abzan, to the point of utter desperation.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daghatar learns why Dromoka massacred his people, shatters the Remembrance and ends the kin-tree practices, forging a pact with the dragon.
timeline.quote: he ignored the dictates of the Remembrance spirits and shattered the relic, pleasing the dragon.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Dromoka necromancy is banned and the Kin-Trees razed, but ancestor worship persists in secret.
timeline.quote: necromancy was banned, the Kin-Trees were razed, and all forms of ancestral communion were strictly prohibited.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Revival of the Abzan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Defectors like Anafenza challenge Dromoka and are killed, but the rebellion gains steam during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: who challenged the dragonlord and were ultimately killed for their disobedience.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Revival of the Abzan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rebellion grows until Dromoka is defeated alongside the other dragonlords.
timeline.quote: eventually leading to Dromoka's defeat alongside the other dragonlords.

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Revival of the Abzan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Felothar rebels against Dromoka after the invasion and is chosen as khan.
timeline.quote: was chosen after rebelling against Dromoka in the aftermath of the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dromoka outlaws trafficking with spirits as necromancy, and the practice is restored after Dromoka is overthrown.
timeline.quote: and when Dromoka was overthrown, it was officially restored.

citation.text: "Spirit", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Some Abzan spirits abandoned during Dromoka's reign turn malevolent and form ancestral maelstroms.
timeline.quote: Some Abzan spirits became malevolent after being abandoned during Dromoka's reign.

citation.text: "Spirit", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Over millennia, Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan.
timeline.quote: Over the millennia, the spirit dragon Ugin's magic coalesced into powerful storms on his native plane of Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Merel warns that the first battle against Dromoka cost over a thousand soldiers with no damage to her, and Daghatar acknowledges the Abzan may be facing the end.
timeline.quote: we may be facing the end of the Abzan.

citation.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Dromoka lands and grants Daghatar an audience, laughing at his plea for peace.
timeline.quote: That will not be possible. Your tribe of necromancers is a stain on her land that she cannot tolerate.

citation.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Dromoka explains that binding the dead to serve the living is necromancy, which she cannot tolerate, though she respects the Abzan.
timeline.quote: as long as your people are tainted by necromancy, our brood will continue to wipe yours clean from the desert.

citation.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The Remembrance urges Daghatar to strike Dromoka, but he chooses instead to sacrifice it.
timeline.quote: Raise me up. Strike your enemy down, now.

citation.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Daghatar orders every kin-tree uprooted and necromancy forbidden, and Dromoka nods; Merel warns of civil war.
timeline.quote: Uproot every kin-tree. The practice of necromancy is hereby forbidden.

citation.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Daghatar receives Yasova's letter about Reyhan's death and orders word sent to the dragonlord to crush the holdouts.
timeline.quote: Tell the dragonlord that if we move now, we can either force the remaining holdouts to surrender…or crush them for good.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The Khanfall: each khan falls and their clans with them; five dragon clans rise under the dragonlords.
timeline.quote: one by one, each of the ancient humanoid khans fell, and their clans fell with them

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's law outlaws ancestor magic as necromancy, and a few renegade spirit speakers hide kin-trees.
timeline.quote: Ancestor magic, once practiced by the distant forebears of the modern-day Dromoka humanoids, is outlawed by the dragonlord as a form of necromancy.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Anafenza is executed for kin-tree worship, but a ghostly figure like her is seen fighting alongside the Dromoka.
timeline.quote: However, she practiced ancient kin-tree worship, and for that she was executed.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's brood massacres the Abzan over necromancy until Khan Daghatar is brought before her; he ends the kin-tree traditions and pacts with dragons.
timeline.quote: he ordered the end of the Abzan kin-tree traditions, installing instead a pact with the dragons

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Anafenza and other defectors challenge the dragonlord and are killed.
timeline.quote: Resistance to Dromoka grew from defectors like Anafenza who challenged the dragonlord and were ultimately killed for their disobedience.

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexian Invasion causes heavy dragon casualties; Dromoka's brood turn to ancestor spirits and rebel.
timeline.quote: many among Dromoka's brood turned to their ancestors

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ritual raises five spirit dragons, who battle the Dragonlords; the Dragonlords are defeated and seemingly swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: In the end, the Dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm.

citation.text: "Dromoka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dromoka's brood massacres the Abzan until Khan Daghatar is brought before her and ends the kin-tree traditions.
timeline.quote: he ordered the end of the Abzan kin-tree traditions, installing instead a pact with the dragons.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daghatar destroys the Remembrance and pledges his clan to Dromoka's service.
timeline.quote: Daghatar destroys the Remembrance

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Reyhan refuses to kneel to the dragon Dromoka, rallies the Abzan as their final khan, and dies in the khanfall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan refused to kneel to a dragon.

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Patrons from different clans quarrel over which rebellion leader was the real hero, while illusions of the dragonlords roar out of the smoke.
timeline.quote: snake-headed Silumgar, Atarka with her crown of antlers, spined Kolaghan, Dromoka shining like the sun, and of course, feathered Ojutai

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
timeline.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 3: What the Past Devours" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset persuades an impatient Elspeth to wait one more hour, explaining the Jeskai-Abzan tension over the dead.
timeline.quote: Dromoka all but informed the Abzan that their clan would be eradicated if they didn't forswear their ancestral worship.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 4: Heart of Fire" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Vasi swears by Dromoka's love not to escape until they have dueled.
timeline.quote: I swear by Dromoka's love that I will not attempt to escape until we've dueled.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Vasi asks whether the rebels can truly stand against Dromoka, and Felothar admits she has doubts but will walk her path.
timeline.quote: "My path is set," Felothar says at last, "and I will walk it.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

timeline.summary: Felothar heads back to the rebel encampment as the camp prepares to depart for battle against Dromoka's forces.
timeline.quote: she does know that her family is stronger than Dromoka imagines.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

relations.note: He translates for Dromoka on behalf of the Eternal.
relations.quote: On behalf of the Eternal, we welcome you.

citation.text: "No End and No Beginning" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Feb 2015.

relations.note: He abdicated the Abzan in favor of Dromoka and now serves under the dragonlord.
relations.quote: Daghatar, khan of the Abzan, recently abdicated in favor of the dragon Dromoka in a desperate bid to save his people.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

relations.note: He commands her legions on her orders.
relations.quote: Even the clan's dragons yield to him on matters of strategy, on orders from Dromoka herself.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

relations.quote: pledging himself and his clan to Dromoka's service.

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

relations.quote: Reyhan refused to kneel to a dragon.

relations.quote: The last time was when the dragonlord stripped her of her place and ordered her execution.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.

relations.note: Vasi begins as a loyalist swearing by Dromoka's love.
relations.quote: "I'm loyal to Dromoka, traitor," Vasi says.

citation.text: "Spirits of the Abzan" by Izzy Wasserstein. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2026.
